_note: Episode 45 (S5E4), story version 2 Kabanata 45: Mactan, Cebu, Bohol, Limasawa, Lake Lanao, the Sulu Sea over three nights; Usman present. Indio in his forties (string of Episodes 48 and 49) in the anting armour. Diwa are light only, no clear face, never a likeness. Tala and Tubal from Episode 46. Battle shown as shields of light, breaking smoke spears, arrows of light pinning shadows (unhurt): nobody is hit. The real 1521 and 1565 scenes are old-print or painted, far figures only. m_beside and cebu_treaty and sarimanok_art are montage extras.
style: Style: modern Japanese TV anime key frame, crisp clean ink line art, cel shading with two-tone hard shadows, vivid saturated colour, expressive face.
white: Anime character illustration, medium shot from the waist up, the whole head and both shoulders visible with space above the head, character centered, on a plain flat solid bright green chroma-key background with nothing else:

full.islands_embers: Night from very high above: scattered southern Philippine islands glowing faintly like embers under a sheet of rain, five small pillars of light rising from five islands. Epic wide shot.
full.five_lights: Night over a dark sea in rain: five distant pillars of warm light on five islands, each with a faint glowing human-shaped figure at its foot. Wide telephoto shot.
full.intro: A swirling golden time portal of clock gears and light opening over a rainy sea at night: a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist stepping toward the viewer beside a black street dog with a white chest patch and a red kerchief, warm confident smile. Medium wide shot.
full.ride_south: Night above the rain clouds over the southern Philippine islands: a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, ornate golden armour plates made of twelve round bronze medallions over a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist riding on the neck of a colossal sea serpent of Philippine folklore with glittering silver-blue scales, a huge mouth and fins like wings, the islands far below, wind and rain. Epic wide shot.
full.mactan_shore: A shallow beach of Mactan island at night in heavy rain, a reef, dark sea, small outrigger boats behind: wide shot of the empty shore with waves rolling in, a lone glowing figure standing at the waterline.
full.lapulapu_diwa: A shallow beach of Mactan island at night in heavy rain, a reef, dark sea, small outrigger boats behind: a tall translucent glowing figure of a pre-colonial Visayan warrior chieftain made of soft blue-gold light, no clear face, arms folded, feet planted in the surf, silent.
full.fisher_boats: A shallow beach of Mactan island at night in heavy rain, a reef, dark sea, small outrigger boats behind: small fishing boats packed with children wrapped in blankets, an old Filipino fisherman with a weathered face and a straw hat standing at the front.
full.kulas_close: A shallow beach of Mactan island at night in heavy rain, a reef, dark sea, small outrigger boats behind: close-up of an old Filipino fisherman with a weathered face and a straw hat, rain on his face, jaw set, saying few words.
full.shadows_sea_mactan: A shallow beach of Mactan island at night in heavy rain, a reef, dark sea, small outrigger boats behind: long dark faceless shadow shapes coming across the reef from the sea toward the shore.
full.shield_dome: A shallow beach of Mactan island at night in heavy rain, a reef, dark sea, small outrigger boats behind: a huge invisible shield shown as a faint shimmering curved wall of golden light in front of the glowing figure on the beach, the sea pressing against it.
full.wave_stops: A shallow beach of Mactan island at night in heavy rain, a reef, dark sea, small outrigger boats behind: a big wave crashing against a shimmering wall of golden light and stopping dead, spray frozen, the boats behind it untouched. Low angle.
full.kampilan_draw: A shallow beach of Mactan island at night in heavy rain, a reef, dark sea, small outrigger boats behind: low angle of a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, ornate golden armour plates made of twelve round bronze medallions over a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist drawing a long single-edged Filipino sword with a forked hilt, its blade glowing white.
full.kampilan_break: A shallow beach of Mactan island at night in heavy rain, a reef, dark sea, small outrigger boats behind: close-up of a glowing long sword striking a shadowy spear made of dark smoke, the spear shattering into ash and sparks, no one hurt.
full.spears_shatter: A shallow beach of Mactan island at night in heavy rain, a reef, dark sea, small outrigger boats behind: many dark smoke spears shattering into ash one after another in a line along the shore, light flashes in the rain. Wide shot.
full.cebu_shelter: Inside a crowded school gym used as an evacuation centre at night in Cebu, families on mats, tired faces, a long table with empty pots.
full.tupas_diwa: Inside a crowded evacuation centre at night: a tall translucent glowing figure of an old pre-colonial Visayan chieftain seated as if at a feast made of soft blue-gold light, no clear face, hands open over a long table.
full.bread_share: Inside a crowded evacuation centre at night: close-up of many hands breaking and passing round loaves of bread, the bread glowing softly and becoming more as it is shared.
full.morning_full: Morning in an evacuation centre: families asleep and content on mats, empty plates, soft daylight through high windows, a few crumbs.
full.bohol_hills: Night in rain on the island of Bohol: rounded grassy hills half under floodwater, a few lights. Wide shot.
full.workers_trapped: Night in rain on a flooded construction site in Bohol: tired construction workers in hard hats stranded on top of a hollow unfinished concrete wall surrounded by water, a wiry Filipino man in his fifties with a rough stubbled face and rust-stained work clothes among them.
full.kalawang_close: Night in rain: close-up of a wiry Filipino man in his fifties with a rough stubbled face and rust-stained work clothes, chewing a nail, hard eyes beginning to soften, water up to his waist.
full.hand_out: Night in rain on a flooded site: a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, ornate golden armour plates made of twelve round bronze medallions over a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist reaching down from a boat with an open hand toward a wiry Filipino man in his fifties with a rough stubbled face and rust-stained work clothes.
full.sandugo_seal: Night in rain: two hands clasped, one with a red handkerchief on the wrist, a thread of warm golden light winding around them, a mysterious young Filipina woman with long black hair in a long dark coat holding a closed red umbrella, a round bronze medallion at her neck's medallion glowing behind.
full.workers_help: Night in rain: construction workers in hard hats carrying children and old people to boats, working together with fishermen, lanterns.
full.kept_word: Night in rain: a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist standing in a boat with the workers, nodding, calm.
full.limasawa_pier: A small island pier at night in rain, Limasawa: a few men in plain shirts standing in the shadows with dark shapes whispering near them, boats tied up.
full.kolambu_diwa: A small island pier at night in rain: a tall translucent glowing figure of a stately pre-colonial Visayan chieftain made of soft blue-gold light, no clear face, both palms open, looking at the men.
full.boat_seats: A small island pier at night in rain: children being lifted into the seats of a wooden boat by their fathers, the dark shapes fading away.
full.oars_trade: A small island pier at night in rain: men handing their wooden oars into a boat as children sit down in it, a soft glow of blue-gold light over the trade.
full.sarimanok_lake: A wide misty mountain lake at night in rain, Lake Lanao, small lit towns along its shores: a giant majestic legendary bird with a rooster-like body, a long sweeping multicoloured tail of red, gold, green and blue feathers and an ornate crest flying low over the water, and behind it a tall translucent glowing figure of a tall Muslim sultan of Mindanao in a turban and robe made of soft blue-gold light, no clear face.
full.kudarat_voice: A wide misty mountain lake at night in rain, Lake Lanao, small lit towns along its shores: a glowing figure of blue-gold light, no clear face, standing on the water, rings of soft golden sound spreading from it across the lake to every shore.
full.kudarat_honest: A wide misty mountain lake at night in rain, Lake Lanao, small lit towns along its shores: close shot of the glowing figure of light, one hand raised flat, calm and serious, no clear face.
full.towns_stand: A wide misty mountain lake at night in rain, Lake Lanao, small lit towns along its shores: people coming out onto the shores of the lake in the rain, standing together, lanterns raised. Wide shot.
full.bow_draw: A wide misty mountain lake at night in rain, Lake Lanao, small lit towns along its shores: a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, ornate golden armour plates made of twelve round bronze medallions over a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist on the back of a giant majestic legendary bird with a rooster-like body, a long sweeping multicoloured tail of red, gold, green and blue feathers and an ornate crest, drawing a short bow with an arrow of white light, twelve glowing arrows in a quiver.
full.arrows_fly: A wide misty mountain lake at night in rain, Lake Lanao, small lit towns along its shores: many arrows of white light streaking down into the dark water of the lake like falling stars. Wide shot.
full.shadows_pinned: A wide misty mountain lake at night in rain, Lake Lanao, small lit towns along its shores: dark shadow shapes rising to the surface of the lake, each pinned to its own reflection by a glowing arrow of light, unable to move, unhurt.
full.sulu_sea: The open Sulu Sea at night under clearing rain, scattered islands and small boats: wide shot, quiet, many small boats drifting apart on the dark water.
full.pahala_diwa: The open Sulu Sea at night under clearing rain, scattered islands and small boats: a tall translucent glowing figure of a sorrowful pre-colonial Sulu king in a long robe made of soft blue-gold light, no clear face, standing on the water, gazing west toward a far land.
full.lost_boats: The open Sulu Sea at night under clearing rain, scattered islands and small boats: small boats scattered by the waves, a frightened child alone in one, a mother calling from another.
full.guided_home: The open Sulu Sea at night under clearing rain, scattered islands and small boats: gentle paths of blue-gold light on the water leading each small boat to a family waiting on a lit shore, a child running into his mother's arms.
full.home_waiting: A lit doorway of a stilt house over the water at night, a grandmother waiting with a lamp, a child climbing up into her arms. Warm and quiet.
full.dawn_tired: Night above the rain clouds over the southern Philippine islands: a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, ornate golden armour plates made of twelve round bronze medallions over a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist riding on the neck of a colossal sea serpent of Philippine folklore with glittering silver-blue scales, a huge mouth and fins like wings, grey first light, the man exhausted, shoulders down, the sea calm below.
full.gear_close: Night above the rain clouds over the southern Philippine islands: a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, ornate golden armour plates made of twelve round bronze medallions over a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist riding on the neck of a colossal sea serpent of Philippine folklore with glittering silver-blue scales, a huge mouth and fins like wings, close-up of the man's hands holding a long sword and a smooth wooden shepherd's crook, a glowing metal leg brace on his leg.
full.holo_count: Night above the rain clouds over the southern Philippine islands: a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, ornate golden armour plates made of twelve round bronze medallions over a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist riding on the neck of a colossal sea serpent of Philippine folklore with glittering silver-blue scales, a huge mouth and fins like wings, close-up of a glowing blue-gold holographic panel with a counter glowing steady, digits blurred and unreadable.
full.usman_ride: Night above the rain clouds over the southern Philippine islands: a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, ornate golden armour plates made of twelve round bronze medallions over a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist riding on the neck of a colossal sea serpent of Philippine folklore with glittering silver-blue scales, a huge mouth and fins like wings, a black street dog with a white chest patch and a red kerchief sitting behind the man on the serpent's neck, wagging, relieved, wet fur.
full.clouds_open: Night above the clouds at first light: the cloud ceiling high above tearing open, revealing a vast endless battlefield of light in the sky, countless tiny flashes, far beyond seeing. Epic wide shot, awe.
full.sky_battle: An endless sky above the clouds: ranks of winged figures of white light facing a vast dark coiling shape across a field of cloud, seen from far below, nobody hit. Epic wide shot.
full.m_beside: Night above the clouds on the neck of a giant silver-blue serpent: a mysterious young Filipina woman with long black hair in a long dark coat holding a closed red umbrella, a round bronze medallion at her neck standing beside a tired man, looking up at the opened sky.
full.m_close: Above the clouds at first light: close-up of a mysterious young Filipina woman with long black hair in a long dark coat holding a closed red umbrella, a round bronze medallion at her neck, calm grave eyes, speaking low.
full.crook_points: Night above the rain clouds over the southern Philippine islands: a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, ornate golden armour plates made of twelve round bronze medallions over a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist riding on the neck of a colossal sea serpent of Philippine folklore with glittering silver-blue scales, a huge mouth and fins like wings, close-up of a smooth wooden shepherd's crook warming with a golden glow in a man's hand, its curved end turning to point straight up at the sky.
full.m_host: Above the clouds: a mysterious young Filipina woman with long black hair in a long dark coat holding a closed red umbrella, a round bronze medallion at her neck speaking, and behind her a faint vast choir of winged figures of white light echoing her, filling the sky.
full.host_wide: Above the clouds at first light: countless winged figures of white light standing in a great half circle around a small serpent and its riders, solemn. Epic wide shot.
full.usman_explain: A cosy simple studio corner with a rain-streaked window: a medium-sized black Philippine street dog with a white chest patch, one folded ear and bright clever eyes, a red kerchief around his neck sitting up straight like a teacher, one paw raised.
full.mactan_1521: Old engraving style, sepia: a shallow beach at dawn, armoured European soldiers wading back toward boats, many island warriors with shields on the shore, smoke, far small figures, no blood, no readable text.
full.sandugo_1565: Painted illustration, warm tones: a Visayan chieftain and a Spanish captain in a 1560s doublet sitting face to face under a tree on Bohol sharing a cup, seen from the side, faces not detailed. No text.
full.cebu_treaty: Painted illustration, warm tones: a Visayan chieftain and a Spanish officer at a plain table on a beach in 1565, a sheet of paper with scribbled unreadable lines between them, ships behind. No text.
full.mazaua_1521: Painted illustration, warm tones: a small green island with a hill, outrigger boats and two sailing ships offshore in 1521, morning light. No text.
full.lanao_1639: Painted illustration, warm tones: a Maguindanao sultan in a turban addressing a gathering of Maranao datus by a misty lake in 1639, seen from behind and far away, no faces visible. No text.
full.dezhou_tomb: Daylight in northern China: a quiet old tomb mound with stone guardian statues and old trees, a plain stone stele with unreadable carvings, autumn leaves. Wide shot.
full.sarimanok_art: Maranao art: a carved and painted sarimanok bird figure with a fish in its beak and curling geometric line art in red, gold and green, on a plain wall.
full.fiction_card: Night sea at first light: six translucent glowing figures of blue-gold light standing on six islands, a great serpent in the sky with riders, winged figures far above. Wide shot.
full.tubal_boat: The open Sulu Sea at night under clearing rain, scattered islands and small boats: far away in a small dark boat with no light, a tall well-groomed grey-haired Filipino man in his sixties in a charcoal suit, a heavy bronze ring on one finger standing still, staring up at the sky.
full.tala_boat: The open Sulu Sea at night under clearing rain, scattered islands and small boats: in a small dark boat with no light, beside a tall grey-haired man in a dark suit, a young woman with long pure white hair and calm grey eyes in a long dark coat, her white hair bright in the gloom, face unreadable.
full.comment: Night above the rain clouds, on the neck of a colossal sea serpent of Philippine folklore with glittering silver-blue scales, a huge mouth and fins like wings: a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist and a black street dog with a white chest patch and a red kerchief turned toward the viewer, the man pointing at the viewer with a small tired smile.
full.question: A lit doorway of a stilt house over the water at night, a lamp on the step, someone waiting inside. Medium shot.
full.follow: Above the clouds at first light: a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, ornate golden armour plates made of twelve round bronze medallions over a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist and a medium-sized black Philippine street dog with a white chest patch, one folded ear and bright clever eyes, a red kerchief around his neck riding on the head of a colossal sea serpent of Philippine folklore with glittering silver-blue scales, a huge mouth and fins like wings straight up toward the opened sky.
